name: A10-0175/2025 – Emma Wiesner, Pekka Toveri – Article 1 – § 1 – point 3; Council Decision 89/367/EEC – Article 2 – paragraph 2 – after point d – Am 22
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Council Decision 89/367/EEC setting up a Standing Forestry Committee
part_text: (d a) provide exchange of knowledge on the multiple functions of forests, including ecosystem services, such as climate regulation, water catchment protection, preventing soil erosion, as well as wood and non-wood products and services and recreational use;
